# Subject + 係 + Noun · *Subject + hai6 + Noun*

**Meaning:** to be (identity) · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Being and having

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fhai6-copula).

係 links a subject to a noun: who or what something is. It is not used before adjectives — say 佢好高 (he is tall), not 佢係高. To negate, use 唔係.

**Written Chinese:** 是 — Written Chinese uses 是; in speech always say 係.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我係學生。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 hai6 hok6 saang1. |
| Yale | ngóh haih hohk sāang. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄏㄛㆶ⁶ ㄙㄚㄥ¹. |
| English | I'm a student. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢係我朋友。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 hai6 ngo5 pang4 jau5. |
| Yale | kéuih haih ngóh pàhng yáuh. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄆㄜㄥ⁴ ㄧㄜㄨ⁵. |
| English | He's my friend. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **呢度係銅鑼灣。** |
| Jyutping | ni1 dou6 hai6 tung4 lo4 waan1. |
| Yale | nī douh haih tùhng lòh wāan. |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄧ¹ ㄉㄛㄨ⁶ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄊㄨㄥ⁴ ㄌㄛ⁴ ㄨㄚㄣ¹. |
| English | This is Causeway Bay. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢係醫生。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 hai6 ji1 sang1. |
| Yale | kéuih haih yī sāng. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄧ¹ ㄙㄜㄥ¹. |

| 漢字 | **今日係星期六。** |
| Jyutping | gam1 jat6 hai6 sing1 kei4 luk6. |
| Yale | gām yaht haih sīng kèih luhk. |

| English | Today is Saturday. |

## Common mistakes

- Not ~~他是學生。~~ but **佢係學生。** *keoi5 hai6 hok6 saang1.* · *kéuih haih hohk sāang.*  
  他 and 是 are written forms. Speech uses 佢 and 係.
